patients.summary: Healthy woman in her late twenties who joined the practice in 2022. A long-standing fear of flying that limits her career is diagnosed by outside psychiatry in 2024 as a specific phobia; after two more psychiatry visits she starts exposure-based CBT with a psychologist in 2026.

documents.title: New patient inquiry
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 26 y/o woman in Southampton looking for a new PCP; her prior PCP retired this summer. Explained the membership model and what insurance still covers. She'd like to get set up. Membership paperwork emailed. Records release emailed with the paperwork; will fax the request to the prior office once it comes back signed. New patient physical booked for 9/20 at 8:40, asked her to come fasting.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Received 22 pages from prior primary care office (seen there 2014 to 2021). Abstracted:
- Problems: none listed.
- Medications: none.
- Allergies: no known drug allergies.
- Surgeries: none.
- Cervical cytology 06/2021: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
- Immunizations: childhood series complete per state record; HPV 3 doses (2008-2009); meningococcal conjugate at 11 and 16; Tdap 05/2017; influenza most years.
- Last visit 06/2021, routine physical, normal.
Scanned to media. Immunizations reconciled into the registry.

documents.title: New Patient Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
26 y/o F establishing care after her prior PCP retired. Works in sales support for a medical device company, mostly office-based, hybrid schedule. No complaints today.

PMH: none. PSH: none. Meds: none, no supplements. Allergies: NKDA.
FH: mother with generalized anxiety; father healthy as far as she knows. Paternal uncle has a fear of heights.
SH: lives on her own in Southampton. Never smoker, no vaping. Alcohol 1-2 drinks a month, out with friends. No drugs. Walks most evenings, yoga on weekends.
GYN: regular cycles. Last Pap 2021 normal per old records.
Prevention: HPV series done as a kid, Tdap 2017. Agrees to flu shot today.

ROS: negative in detail.

Exam: well appearing, pleasant. Vitals reviewed. HEENT unremarkable, thyroid not enlarged. Lungs clear. Heart RRR, no murmur. Abd soft, nontender. Skin clear. Extremities warm, no swelling. Mood and affect normal.

PHQ-2 0. GAD-7 3.

A/P: healthy adult, preventive visit.
- Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH. One-time HIV and hep C screening, she agrees.
- Flu vaccine given.
- Next Pap due 2024.
- COVID booster at her pharmacy this fall, she'll send the date.
Return in a year.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Deepa, everything from Tuesday is back and normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, thyroid and cholesterol. HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to follow up on. Good to have you with us.

documents.title: Outside immunization
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pt sent a photo of her vaccine card via portal. Pfizer bivalent COVID booster given 11/2/22 at a retail pharmacy. Entered into the record.

documents.title: Wellness form for work
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my company does a wellness incentive and they want a form filled out by a doctor with blood pressure, BMI and cholesterol. Can I use the numbers from my September physical or do I need to come in? I attached the form. Thanks, Deepa

documents.title: RE: Wellness form for work
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: No visit needed, September's numbers are recent enough for this. Form is filled in and signed, it's in your documents tab to download. Let us know if HR wants it faxed instead.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly visit. Feels well. Busy stretch at work with a product launch, sleeping fine. Still walking, added a weekly spin class. No new meds. NKDA. Social history unchanged, never smoker, alcohol a couple of times a month.

ROS negative.

Exam: NAD. Vitals reviewed, BP normal. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Lungs clear bilaterally. RRR without murmur. Abdomen benign. Skin without concerning lesions. Normal mood and affect.

PHQ-2 0, GAD-7 2.

A/P: well adult.
- CBC, CMP.
- Flu shot today.
- Pap due next year.
- Updated COVID vaccine when the pharmacy has it.
See her next September.

documents.title: Lab results from your physical
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Hi Deepa, the doctor reviewed your blood work from Tuesday and it is all normal. No changes. Have a good fall!
